description: This file contains the code-behind logic for the 'EditTheory' web page of an online examination system. It manages navigation between pages, session state, and populates course selection dropdowns based on semester selection.

classes.name: OnlineExamSystem.EditTheory
classes.description: Partial class for managing the logic of the 'EditTheory' webpage in the online exam system.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles initial page load event; currently does nothing.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the Admin Panel page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the Admin Queue page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the Admin Leaderboard page.

methods.name: searchB_Click
methods.description: Stores selected course text into session variable '_CRS'.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the Login Page.

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Populates the course dropdown based on selected semester from predefined lists.

methods.name: selectSemesterDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates course dropdown options based on the newly selected semester.

methods.name: SelectCourseDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Currently empty; could be used for handling course selection changes.
